messages:
iveliz-recruiter: Candidate (J. Bennett) just DM'd: their car broke down en route, might be 90+ mins late. They can do the loop remotely if needed. Can we stand up remote fallback + offer rideshare or parking reimbursement if they still try to come?

harry-peopleops: Sorry to hear that. Remote fallback is available. We can approve rideshare up to $60 or reimburse parking. Also happy to shift start later if panel can.

matt-it: I'll prepare LOANER-5577 (MacBook + headphones) and a hotspot in case candidate prefers to come but needs better connection. Leave at reception with label BENNETT-5577.

sana-hiringmgr: Panel can push by 90 mins to accommodate if they want to come. If remote, Olivia can host the shared editor and screen-share.

olivia-panel: I can host CodePair and cover extra 30 minutes if needed. Send me the Zoom link and Ill be ready.

facilities-bot: Reception hold placed for LOANER-5577 at 13:00. Parking voucher reserved up to $25. Room "Focus-1" held from 14:30-16:30 in case candidate arrives.

harry-peopleops: Logistics recap: remote fallback + Zoom ready; LOANER-5577 on hold; rideshare/reimbursement approved up to $60; panel flexible to shift. iveliz  please confirm with candidate what they prefer and update here.

iveliz-recruiter: DM sent. Candidate prefers to try rideshare and will update in 20 mins. I'll post back once they confirm.
